correctness.finding: PASS. The corrected Cartan matrix is right. In characteristic 2, kS3 has a principal block whose trivial simple has projective cover with two trivial composition factors and a defect-zero 2-dimensional simple that is projective, giving corner Cartan diag(2,1); kC2 has Cartan [2]. For the 3-point transitive S3 orbit, the permutation module splits as T⊕W because the constant vector is not in the sum-zero plane in characteristic 2, and W is the 2-dimensional simple. Adding the fixed point gives M_R≅T⊕T⊕W. Every order-4 stabilizer for the 3-orbit in C2×S3 contains the central C2 factor, so the left C2 action is trivial. Therefore the y-projective has factors 2S1+S2+2S3 and the full row-by-projective Cartan matrix is [[2,0,0],[0,1,0],[2,1,2]], with determinant 4.
